senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。

ex.en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
ex.zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。

tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or its language.
The language used by most people in Japan.
A person from Japan, or the people of Japan collectively.

ex.en: We enjoyed Japanese food at a small restaurant yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在一家小餐馆吃了日本料理。

ex.en: Studying Japanese architecture can help students understand how traditional design responds to local environmental conditions.
ex.zh: 研究日本建筑可以帮助学生理解传统设计如何适应当地环境条件。

tip: 首字母始终大写；指一个日本人常用a Japanese person。

senses.en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing
to apply ink to a surface

ex.en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
ex.zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。

col: run out of ink｜墨水用完
tip: ink作名词通常不可数；“用墨水写”用in ink。

senses.en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something
An order telling someone what they must do
The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject

ex.en: The instructor gave one clear instruction: hold the rope tightly.
ex.zh: 教练给出了一条明确指示：紧紧抓住绳子。

ex.en: Students often benefit from practical instruction that connects classroom theory with everyday problems.
ex.zh: 将课堂理论与日常问题联系起来的实践教学往往能让学生受益。

tip: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。

senses.en: An evening meal, sometimes a light meal before bed.

ex.en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
ex.zh: 我们晚饭喝了汤，吃了新鲜面包。

ex.en: Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.
ex.zh: 尽管工作安排日益繁忙，经常共进晚餐仍有助于家人维持亲密关系。

tip: 常指较随意的晚饭，也可指睡前便餐。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: The fisherman pulled his net onto the wooden boat.
ex.zh: 渔民把渔网拉上了木船。

ex.en: Each fisherman in the coastal village depends on healthy marine ecosystems to maintain a reliable income.
ex.zh: 这个沿海村庄的每位渔民都依靠健康的海洋生态系统来维持稳定收入。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots
very much or often, in the phrase a lot
an area of land used for a particular purpose

ex.en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
ex.zh: 我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。

ex.en: Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通并鼓励居民步行来节约大量能源。

col: a lot of time｜大量时间
tip: a lot of接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot可修饰动词。

senses.en: Used to connect alternatives or choices
Used to introduce what happens if something is not done

ex.en: Would you like rice or noodles with your vegetables?
ex.zh: 蔬菜配米饭还是面条，你想选哪一种？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport or face increasing congestion and air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则大城市将面临日益严重的拥堵和空气污染。

tip: 否定句中连接并列项常用or，不用and。

senses.en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.

ex.en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
ex.zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。

ex.en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
ex.zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。

tip: maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

senses.en: something you should do because it is right or required
work required by a job or a period of service
a tax charged on certain goods

ex.en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
ex.zh: 保护这些动物的安全是我的责任。

ex.en: Governments have a duty to protect vulnerable citizens while ensuring that public services remain financially sustainable.
ex.zh: 政府有责任保护弱势公民，同时确保公共服务在财政上可持续。

tip: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: The number equal to three groups of ten.

ex.en: The soup needs another thirty minutes on the stove.
ex.zh: 这锅汤还需要在炉子上再煮三十分钟。

ex.en: The survey found that thirty per cent of residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
ex.zh: 调查发现，百分之三十的居民在短途出行时更愿意骑车而不是开车。

col: in your thirties｜在三十多岁时
tip: thirty重音在前；thirteen重音通常在后。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
ex.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

ex.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

senses.en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations

ex.en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。

ex.en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
ex.zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。

tip: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something
an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance

ex.en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。

ex.en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
ex.zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。

tip: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

senses.en: one of two equal parts of something
equal to one of two equal parts of something
to an extent that is not complete

ex.en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
ex.zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。

ex.en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。

tip: 复数为halves；“半小时”用half an hour。

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.
Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
ex.zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。

ex.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
ex.zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.en: the number 80

senses.zh: 八十的，八十个的；八十岁的

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.
Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
ex.zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。

ex.en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
ex.zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。

tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

senses.en: a woman who is married to someone

ex.en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
ex.zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。

ex.en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。

tip: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

senses.en: Coming after the eleventh in a sequence.
One of twelve equal parts of something.

ex.en: We celebrated her twelfth birthday with a homemade cake.
ex.zh: 我们用自制蛋糕庆祝了她的十二岁生日。

ex.en: By the twelfth month of the programme, most participants had developed more effective study habits.
ex.zh: 到该项目的第十二个月时，大多数参与者已经养成了更有效的学习习惯。

col: one twelfth of｜……的十二分之一
tip: twelve变序数词为twelfth，注意ve变为f。

senses.en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees

ex.en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
ex.zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。

ex.en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。

col: a pair of shorts｜一条短裤
tip: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

senses.en: To form words on paper or a screen.
To create a story, article, or piece of music.
To send someone a letter or written message.

ex.en: Please write your address on this small card.
ex.zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。

ex.en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

senses.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
ex.zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use
a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
ex.zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

col: a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

senses.en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

senses.en: a public road in a town, usually lined with buildings

ex.en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们穿过街道来到面包店。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 沿繁忙街道植树可以改善空气质量，让城市街区更适宜步行。

tip: street多指城镇中两旁有建筑的道路。

senses.en: Something known or proved to be true.

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
ex.zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
ex.zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

tip: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens
a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。

ex.en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

tip: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

senses.en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events
an account of something that happened to someone

ex.en: Grandfather told us a tale about a clever fox.
ex.zh: 祖父给我们讲了一个聪明狐狸的故事。

ex.en: Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
ex.zh: 传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。

tip: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。

tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

senses.en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals.
A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes.
To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
ex.zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
ex.zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

col: oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

ex.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。

ex.en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。

col: have a lovely time｜玩得愉快
a lovely person｜友善可亲的人
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

ex.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
ex.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

ex.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.en: making little or no noise
having little activity or excitement
a state with little or no noise

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。

ex.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

tip: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

senses.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance
to check what someone knows or how something performs

ex.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。

ex.en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。

tip: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

senses.en: have someone or something as part of a whole
make someone or something part of a group or activity

ex.en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
ex.zh: 这个价格包含早餐和一条干净毛巾吗？

ex.en: Urban development plans should include affordable housing and reliable public transport to support low-income residents.
ex.zh: 城市发展规划应包含经济适用住房和可靠的公共交通，以支持低收入居民。

col: include a range of｜包含一系列
tip: include常列出部分内容，不表示完整清单。

senses.en: simple, without decoration or a pattern
easy to see or understand
a large area of flat land

ex.en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
ex.zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。

ex.en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
ex.zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。

tip: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm
A person's soul or a being without a physical body
A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation

ex.en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
ex.zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。

ex.en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。

col: a spirit of cooperation｜合作精神
tip: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

senses.en: a room or building where people do administrative work
a place providing a particular service or handling official business
an official position of responsibility, especially in government

ex.en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
ex.zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排让员工能够把工作时间分配在办公室和家中。

tip: 在办公室用in the office；任公职用in office。

senses.en: physically well and not suffering from illness
helping to maintain or improve health
successful, strong, or developing in a positive way

ex.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。

ex.en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校应提供健康膳食，以促进儿童身体发育，并鼓励他们从小养成更好的饮食习惯。

col: a healthy lifestyle｜健康的生活方式
tip: 既可形容身体健康，也可形容饮食等有益健康。

senses.zh: 第二十的；二十分之一的

ex.en: One twentieth of the total output was exported.
ex.zh: 产量中有二十分之一出口。

senses.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

ex.en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
ex.zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。

tip: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。

senses.en: intelligent or showing good judgment
neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion
using computer technology to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
ex.zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。

ex.en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
ex.zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。

tip: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

senses.en: a large black and white bear native to China

ex.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
ex.zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。

ex.en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

tip: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

senses.en: An open area with grass and trees for public enjoyment.
To stop a vehicle somewhere and leave it there.
An area set aside for a particular activity or purpose.

ex.en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
ex.zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。

ex.en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
ex.zh: 让每个社区步行可达公园，有助于鼓励锻炼并加强社区联系。

tip: 公园用park；英式英语中停车场用car park。

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
ex.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一个下雪的早晨。

ex.en: Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.
ex.zh: 与城市儿童相比，出生在农村的儿童获得专科医疗服务可能更加困难。

col: be born into a family｜出生在某个家庭
a born leader｜天生的领导者
tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。

senses.en: improvement or movement towards a goal
to improve or move towards a more advanced stage

ex.en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
ex.zh: 你的游泳水平确实有了进步。

ex.en: Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
ex.zh: 定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。

tip: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

senses.en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes

ex.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
ex.zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。

ex.en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
ex.zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。

col: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马
tip: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: A female child or young woman

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

senses.en: To express words or writing in another language
To change something into a different form or practical result

ex.en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这份食谱翻译成英语吗？

ex.en: Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 政府必须把环保承诺转化为切实的政策，鼓励企业减少排放。

col: translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

senses.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen
do something despite the possibility of harm or loss

ex.en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
ex.zh: 穿结实的鞋子可以降低滑倒的风险。

ex.en: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
ex.zh: 政府在批准河流附近的新住宅开发项目之前，应评估洪水风险。

tip: risk后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality
to rank highest or be greater than something

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
ex.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
ex.zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

senses.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
ex.zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。

ex.en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a piece of candy｜一块糖果
a candy bar｜一条巧克力糖
tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

senses.en: the direction where the sun sets, opposite east
in or facing the direction where the sun sets
towards or in the west

ex.en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝西，能照到傍晚的阳光。

ex.en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。

tip: 方位一般小写；the West指西方国家时大写。

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

ex.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。

ex.en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

senses.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.
Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。

ex.en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
ex.zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

col: successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

senses.en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
A formal social occasion at which people eat a meal.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
ex.zh: 晚饭做好了，请把盘子拿来。

ex.en: Sharing dinner regularly can strengthen family relationships by giving everyone an opportunity to discuss their daily experiences.
ex.zh: 经常共进晚餐能让每个人有机会交流日常经历，从而增进家庭关系。

tip: 日常说 have dinner，不加冠词；正式宴会可说 a dinner。

senses.en: someone you do not know
someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community

ex.en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
ex.zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。

ex.en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。

col: stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人
tip: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。

ex.en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
ex.zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。

ex.en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
ex.zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。

col: war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

senses.en: going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something

ex.en: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
ex.zh: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

senses.en: a large green-skinned fruit with juicy, usually red flesh

ex.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
ex.zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。

ex.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
ex.zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

col: a slice of watermelon｜一片西瓜
tip: 整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

senses.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat
Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation

ex.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
ex.zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。

ex.en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
ex.zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

senses.en: towards the front or a later time
to send something received to another person or place
an attacking player in sports such as football

ex.en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
ex.zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。

col: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展
put forward a proposal｜提出建议
tip: look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands
to increase in amount or level
an act of moving upwards or an increase in level

ex.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山坡，然后停下来野餐。

ex.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。

col: a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段
tip: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

ex.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
ex.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

tip: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

senses.en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject.
A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.

ex.en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
ex.zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。

ex.en: Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.
ex.zh: 对交通政策的公开讨论可以帮助政府设计更符合居民需求的服务。

tip: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
ex.zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

ex.en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
ex.zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

senses.en: Enough or more than enough of something.
To a sufficient degree or a large extent.
A state in which resources are abundant.

ex.en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
ex.zh: 剩下的汤足够大家喝。

ex.en: Although cities offer plenty of employment opportunities, high housing costs can discourage young workers from moving there.
ex.zh: 尽管城市提供大量就业机会，高昂的住房成本仍可能让年轻劳动者不愿迁入。

col: a time of plenty｜富足的时期
tip: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

senses.en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
one of the separate sections of a train

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: having a pale red colour
a colour made by mixing red with white

ex.en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
ex.zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。

ex.en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
ex.zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。

tip: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

senses.en: having no doubt about something
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something.
Flat and even, or at the same height.
To make a surface flat or things equal.

ex.en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
ex.zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。

ex.en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。

col: a high level of｜高水平的；大量的
level the playing field｜创造公平竞争环境
tip: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

senses.en: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

tip: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.

ex.en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。

ex.en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
ex.zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。

col: a slice of pie｜一块馅饼
tip: pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

senses.en: all people living in an area, or their total number
all organisms of one species living in a particular area

ex.en: The village population grows when families move here.
ex.zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。

ex.en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。

tip: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: Unpleasant to look at.
Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.

ex.en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
ex.zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。

tip: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

senses.zh: 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西
senses.en: good things that happen to you by chance

ex.en: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
ex.zh: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

ex.en: He’s had good luck with his roses this year.
ex.zh: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。
